method: Each entry is a separate action a level-2/3 source clause grants (QC1 V135 R1), found by source-only audit agents and quoted verbatim (link markup removed). Conduit had none; Summoner is V138.

actions.name: Disciple of the Green: Great Cat Jump
actions.quote: As a maneuver, you can jump up to 3 squares in any direction.

actions.name: There Is No Space Between: Additional Portal
actions.quote: At the start of each of your turns while the portals are active, you can open a new portal connected to the others.

actions.name: There Is No Space Between: End Portals
actions.quote: end the effect as a maneuver

actions.name: A Conversation With Fire: End Conversation
actions.quote: As a maneuver, you or the creature can end the conversation.

actions.name: Distance Is Only Memory: Dismiss Portal
actions.quote: until you dismiss it as a main action

actions.parent: O Flower Aid, O Earth Defend
actions.name: O Flower Aid, O Earth Defend: Allow Recoveries
actions.quote: Once as a free maneuver at the start of your turn, you allow yourself and each ally in the area to spend any number of Recoveries.

actions.parent: O Flower Aid, O Earth Defend
actions.name: O Flower Aid, O Earth Defend: Move Area
actions.quote: As a maneuver, you can move the area up to 5 squares.

actions.name: Earth Accepts Me: Exit Object
actions.quote: You can travel through the object freely until you exit it.

actions.name: Slow: End Effect
actions.quote: You can end the effect on all affected targets at any time (no action required).

actions.name: Companion: Omnomnom: Regurgitate
actions.quote: Your companion can also regurgitate a swallowed creature as a free maneuver.

actions.name: Beastheart: Jaws of Death: Pull
actions.quote: you can pull the target up to a number of squares equal to your Intuition score as a free triggered action.
